justifications.r1: Fast mana rocks (Ancient Tomb, Mox Diamond) and explosive Goblin ramp.
justifications.r2: The One Ring, Skullclamp, and impulse draw keep hands refueled.
justifications.a1: Goblin Matron, Goblin Recruiter, and imperial tutors.
justifications.a2: Assembles Krenko + untap loop on Turns 4–5.
justifications.p1: Presents infinite goblin loops and lethal swarm on Turns 4–5.
justifications.p2: 0–1 opponent untap steps once combo executes with haste.
justifications.p3: Telegraphed Krenko, but fast stack-based untap activations.
justifications.i1: Deflecting Swat, Chaos Warp, and burn.
justifications.s1: Deflecting Swat, Lightning Greaves, and fast haste.
justifications.s2: Vulnerable to sweepers if Krenko is removed before untap.
justifications.s3: Deck heavily built around Krenko's doubling tap ability.
